articles.title: Sanjay Leela Bhansali, Alia Bhatt in talks to revive shelved Salman Khan starrer 'Inshallah'
articles.summary: Sanjay Leela Bhansali and Alia Bhatt are reportedly discussing a revival of their shelved project Inshallah after 'Love and War.' Originally announced in 2019 with Salman Khan and Alia Bhatt, the film was stalled after creative differences between Bhansali and Salman. According to Mid-Day, the filmmaker and actor are now considering a substantially reworked version of the love story.

articles.title: FIRE BREAKS OUT at Talat Aziz's Juhu residence
articles.summary: Talat Aziz, his wife Bina, and their two sons were hospitalized due to smoke inhalation from a fire. The incident occurred at their duplex apartment in Juhu late on Friday night.

articles.title: Mohanlal says 'Thenmavin Kombathu' is his favourite
articles.summary: Mohanlal has expressed that 'Thenmavin Kombathu' is his favorite collaboration with filmmaker Priyadarshan. The film is set to re-release in theatres on October 8 after a gap of 32 years.
